FN-2JYXPSK-1
FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 297
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Economic Development Sponsor: Senator Garlan Gudger
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 04/09/2025
Senate Bill 297 as introduced could increase or decrease the obligations of the Office of Water
Resources, within the Alabama Department of Economic and Community Affairs, beginning in
Fiscal Year 2026 by an undetermined amount, dependent on the difference in (1) the
compensation of the current merit-based division chief position ($102,581 in the 2024 Fiscal
Year) and (2) the compensation of the non-merit division chief position pursuant to this bill.
